arithmetic_class: exact substitution (byte-identical on the exercised matrix)
summary: The gfx1100 production profile prefers the staged multi-row attention candidate for one geometry: a sliding prefill block the tiled and AOTriton routes refuse (a sliding layer whose presented key count exceeds its window), which the native exact kernel serves by walking all presented keys from column 0. The candidate keeps the native arithmetic and adds the per-row window trim. On a same-process paired A/B at 8192 prompt / 128 output the substitution lowers prefill 9.4851 -> 8.3245 s (-12.24%) and wall 11.3942 -> 10.3258 s (-9.38%), and raises decode 1.9089 -> 2.0291 s (+6.29%). This is a scoped prefill/wall win, not a universal non-regression and not full-goal completion.
